description: Eleven outdoor saunas for the garden, from €2,707 for a 1.7 m barrel to €15,892 for the three-room Sauna XL. Two barrel saunas, one sauna pod and eight cabin saunas, all in pine or spruce with 44–45 mm walls, delivered to the UK, Ireland and Europe. Which type? A barrel sauna is the quickest to place and heats evenly; the 5.9 m version adds a changing room. The sauna pod (2.4 × 1.9 m) fits a small garden or a glamping pitch. Cabin saunas give more room, larger glazing and, on Sauna L and XL, a separate rest or changing room. How many people? The barrel 1.7 m, the pod and the cabins Pulse, Zen, Nova, S and M are listed for 2–4 people; the 5.9 m barrel, Sauna L and Sauna XL for 4–8. Construction. Barrel, pod, Pulse, Zen, Nova and Amber have 44 mm solid pine walls and a bitumen-shingle roof. Sauna S, M, L and XL are built from 45 × 185 mm profiled spruce beams with a low-pitch modern roof and tempered glazing. On site. A level, dry base, clear ventilation and the distances in the heater manual. An electric heater needs a qualified electrician. See what a garden sauna costs. Pair it with a wood-fired hot tub. Retailers and hotels: saunas for trade.
